title: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material | TechCrunch
summary: Meta said its latest AI tools are aimed at people using ads that look harmless to send users to illegal content outside Meta’s platforms. Meta is also using additional AI-driven scans to find child exploitation content that earlier systems may have missed.
